### BEI-01: Influence Awareness Index (Pre)

"On a scale of 1–10, how aware are you of who influences you—and who you influence? 1 = I never think about influence. 10 = I consciously manage who influences me and how I influence others."

### INVESTIGATION 1: THE HOOK

MISSION: Meet someone who discovered her influence without knowing it.

YOU WILL PRODUCE:
● ☐ A prediction about what you would do

TIME: 5 minutes

DIFFICULTY:          Observe

### 📖 Read

Episode 1: The Girl Who Asked the Right Question

Meet Atlehang.

Atlehang is quiet. She has always been quiet. She notices things. She asks questions. She remembers what people say. But she has never thought of herself as influential.

She is sixteen. She lives in Alexandra. She goes to the same school as Myah. She has seen Myah's notebook. She has seen Myah write. She has seen Myah change.

One day, Myah tells her about the grant office. About the silence. About the proposal that was ignored for three months.

"I don't know what to do," Myah says. "I've tried everything."

Atlehang listens. Then she asks one question:

"Did you ask them why?"

Myah stops. She stares at Atlehang. "What?"

"Did you ask them why they didn't respond? Not to complain. To understand."

Myah thinks. She has not asked why. She has complained. She has been angry. She has not asked.

The next day, Myah walks back into the grant office. She asks why. They tell her—her proposal was incomplete. She had missed a form. She can resubmit.

She resubmits. She gets the grant.

She starts her mini-business. She becomes the challenger.

All because of one question from a quiet girl.

Atlehang never thought of herself as a leader. She never thought of herself as influential. But she influenced Myah more than anyone else that year.

She did not speak loudly. She did not command attention. She just saw something others missed. She asked the question that needed to be asked.

She is sixteen. She changed Myah's path.

She still doesn't believe she did anything special.

### INVESTIGATION 3: THE REVELATION

MISSION: Discover the hidden truth about influence.

YOU WILL PRODUCE:
● ☐ Understanding of influence as quiet power
● ☐ Prediction calibration check

TIME: 3 minutes

DIFFICULTY:           Analyse

### 📖 Read

Episode 2: What Atlehang Didn't See

Atlehang changed Myah's path with one question. She did not speak loudly. She did not command attention. She just asked the question that needed to be asked.

But here is what nobody told her: influence is not about volume. It is about presence.

Most people think influence is about being loud. Commanding attention. Being the centre of every room. But Atlehang did none of those things. She was quiet. She asked one question. And it changed Myah's entire trajectory.

She still doesn't believe she did anything special.

The next day, she walks past the spaza shop. The shelf is finished. Myah, Sipho, Lethabo, Thabo, and Mr. Patel are standing around it.

"Atlehang!" Myah calls. "You have to see this."

Atlehang walks over. She looks at the shelf. It is solid. It is useful. It was built by people who did not know each other a few weeks ago.

"We couldn't have done this without you," Myah says.

Atlehang looks confused. "I didn't build anything."

"You asked the question," Myah says. "Without that question, I wouldn't have gone back to the grant office. Without that question, I wouldn't have started my business. Without that question, I wouldn't be here."

Atlehang looks at the shelf. She looks at Myah. She looks at the others.

She is sixteen. She changed Myah's path.

She still doesn't believe she did anything special.

But she is starting to wonder.
